_meta.io.cryptofeed402/use_when: Use when you need a ready-made crypto market summary for a user, report or daily briefing.

description: Use when you need a ready-made crypto market summary for a user, report or daily briefing. Latest twice-daily crypto market brief ($0.015/call, USDC on Base via x402), JSON + markdown: headline and bottom line, news sentiment and Fear & Greed, funding rates and open interest with crowded-trade flags, watchlist prices with 24h/7d moves, top news, macro calendar and token unlocks for the next 7 days. For agents writing reports. Stale/missing brief: 503, no charge. Free preview: get_sample_brief. Example: GET https://cryptofeed402.site/brief/latest
name: get_latest_brief
